ExecutionCausalParent.title: ExecutionCausalParent
ExecutionCausalParent.description: Causal parent of an execution event: an earlier event in the same execution stream (the W010 shape).

ExecutionStreamId.title: ExecutionStreamId
ExecutionStreamId.description: Opaque execution-event stream identity: "stream:" followed by a lowercase slug (the W010 stream grammar).

ExecutionEventSequence.title: ExecutionEventSequence
ExecutionEventSequence.description: One execution-event sequence number: 1-based, contiguous per execution stream.
